title: kith-jmap: peer/owner spawn blocks in dispatch_one are duplicated
description: dispatch_one has identical spawn-and-match-error blocks for peer (lines 480-488) and owner (lines 499-507). The only structural difference is that peer passes caller_identity. Suggest: extract to a generic async fn that accepts a HandlerFuture and returns Invocation — the role-dispatch just builds the future differently.
